value.rationale: The 18 Eckardt points are the maximal classical configuration on a diagonal cubic surface, and the degree-four quartic doubling all 18 is a strong special interpolation phenomenon: 18 generic double points in P3 have no quartic through them. Exact minimal generators, the single symbolic defect, and the full 72-length Hilbert function are intrinsic, motivated invariants across all diagonal coefficient choices and nonsplit fields. This is an evaluated natural finite scheme, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
